summary: The only traced reviewer was paid by the agent's own owner. That is too few reviewers to call a pattern. That is not an accusation of fraud, and a paid campaign can be perfectly legitimate. It does mean that much of the score is not independent evidence, because the party being rated paid for those reviewers to exist.
findings: 1 reviewer was paid by the owner through 1 intermediary wallet, which a direct owner-to-reviewer check does not see.
Every rating came from one single address.

signals.title: Owner funded other agents' reviewers
signals.desc: This agent's owner has not paid any wallet that reviewed a different agent.

signals.title: Cross-agent review overlap
signals.desc: None of this agent's reviewers reviewed any other agent.

signals.title: Circular funding
signals.desc: No reviewer paid money back to a wallet that funded it.

signals.title: Funder fan-out
signals.desc: A funder of this agent's reviewers paid 177 different wallets over more than a day (0x53fb2e...5805). Alone this is circumstantial: a busy funder looks the same as an exchange.

signals.title: Shared funding source
signals.desc: No single person-sized wallet paid two or more of this agent's reviewers.

signals.title: Wallets created together
signals.desc: No 3 or more of this agent's reviewers first received money within one day of each other.

signals.title: Automated review timing
signals.desc: No reviewer left 6 or more reviews of this agent at near-identical intervals. Most agents have too few reviews to tell.

limits.fundingAsset: USDC, which is also Arc's gas coin, so plain sends are included
limits.paymentTiming: A payment is timed against the payer's FIRST payment to this owner. A later payment by an already-paying wallet is not separately timed. Times are block numbers.
limits.note: A verdict is a statement about where money came from, not about anyone's intent. Absence of a funding link is weaker evidence than a link, because a wallet funded outside the scanned window, or through a wallet not paid directly, is not visible.
